summary: Completed frontend-only, read-only validation of PHASE 2 Edit-flow refactor on live app. Logged in as admin, opened existing Edit records across Scope 1/2/3/Biogenic without saving, and verified hydrated values plus dynamic field rendering through shared derivation pipeline.

integration_issues.flow: Open Edit dialog (auto/live calculation while hydrating)
integration_issues.issue: Browser console consistently logs 400 for /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category during edit-session interactions; form still hydrates and remains usable read-only.

action_items: Investigate and suppress/handle /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category 400 during Edit hydration so derivation checks are not obscured by console errors.
Optionally add a dedicated read-only guard/path to prevent unnecessary calc-engine execute calls when users only open/inspect Edit records.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/Emissions.js is 3474 lines (>700 guideline) and remains high-risk for regressions despite successful Phase 2 behavior; continue modular split to isolate edit orchestration from UI rendering.

Edit hydration currently triggers a calc-engine execute request path that can emit 400 responses during non-save flows; this should be explicitly error-handled to avoid noisy console and hidden real regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated read-only edit hydration using data-testid selectors: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button, emissions-page, scope-tab-scope1/scope2/scope3/biogenic, edit-emission-*, emission-form, category-select, scope3-method-select, edit-use-custom-fuel-toggle, edit-custom-fuel-name-input, biogenic-scope-radio-scope1/scope3. Observed live records: scope1=55, scope2=28, scope3=247, biogenic=6. Confirmed custom fuel record opened with preserved value (name='Mixed fuelss'). Scope3 method change activity_basis->supplier_basis updated dynamic label signature without save.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: Login -> /ghg/scope1 -> open any edit record (and similarly scope2/scope3/biogenic). Browser console shows HTTP 400 from /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category while form hydrates successfully. Likely cause is eager/live calculation execution during intermediate hydration state (before full decision/input context settles), resulting in invalid payload at least once per edit session. Mitigation: debounce/guard execute call until required inputs/context are complete for the selected formula and scope/method combination, or gracefully swallow expected transient 4xx during hydration-only phase.
